the potential truth and why it may be indigestible purely hypothesis this was originally a comment i formulated in response to a previous post i think this idea is worthy of its own discussion a hypothesis about what might be happening and why i dont know for sure but a good hypothesis that fits the data is that aliens are decentralised there are no galactic councils unified alien agendas secret treaties chosen humans or cosmic morality plays basically alien visitors to earth could just be lone actors from civilizations in which owning a spaceship is like owning a car and a visit to earth is as simple as going for a sight seeing drive some of these actors could be curious amateur civilians of their respective civilization which like humanity has a scale of morality hobbyists and sadist psychopaths alike can own cars on earth and go where they like take all these things into account no central authority mixed ethics amateur professional actors accidents negligence indifference rare extreme harm no narrative closure this would explain the conflicting messages and accounts present in many contact and abductions eg space brothersgalactic federationpositive contact vs bad aliens websitenegative abductionmutilation the government possibly dont want to admit that an alien sociopath with an amateur interest in biology could come here take you and do nightmarish things to you with no way of anyone or anything being able to stop them or help you theres no meaningful pattern because each individual alien has their own interests some may be curious but kind respectful and well intentioned another member of the same species may be retired bored and looking for a way to spend their time another may be an immature youngster with an interest in animalorganism human cruelty they can come here and do as they please due to their advanced technology and no one at their home world cares about the safetymorality of beings lightyears across the universe they have their own lives to live even if they did care would their technology or social culture allow them to be monitored as an example i could get in my car right now drive to a field in the next town dig up some earth worms disect them out of curiosity dump the remains on the spot thereby avoiding any consequences and return home for dinner with no one in my house having an idea about where i had been or what i had done meanwhile for the sake of metaphor the worms in the field are freaking out what the hell was that where did that come from how did it get here and why did it do this it could be that the universe is busy messy indifferent and not organised around us and thats it no federation no alien military just explorers scientists or thrill seekers this could possibly explain crashes too some of these beings could be ill prepared inexperienced in space travel maintenance of a ship something goes wrong their stuck here an embarrassing situation you give vague platitudes to your captures such as no wars no pollution look after each other and your planet you know your never getting home but you cant risk arming your captures with potentially world altering tech and you inadvertently become a representative of your entire species if things went anymore wrong you could be in even more trouble than you already are aliens could be the equivalent of tourists trampling fragile ecosystems amateurs handling dangerous equipment people who didnt think it through and yes occasionally monsters this explained to the average person could cause panic anxiety and lost faith in government and leaderships ability to protect its people

vispion is a social ecosystem built around control privacy context and intent vispion is a social ecosystem divides the social and private lifein the form of spaces of an individual to prevent overwhelming caused due to context overload from regular social media feeds the private space is meant for those whom you privately follow close friends and family the private space is away from any type of algorithm this space is purely private and respects privacy the social space is meant to explore whatever you post here will be visible to the whole platform socially follow anyone in your social circle in this space d the feed controls in the settings lets you control what type of content you see this grants you uttermost control on you social feed it wont effect your private space as they will have all the organic posts from your friends and family

looking for feedback on my space trash management simulator hello feel capable of managing the waste output of a planetary power corp your job is easy produce power reach goals shoot waste into space and if you want use the companys satellites to explore space of course if you fail everybody dies this is my first proper game i want to finish and release right now im almost done with all major systems and will go into a more content driven phase soon but before that i want to find out if the core mechanics are actually working and are fun so dear godot friends please give it a go this is not supposed to be promo or anything the game is in an early but playable stage and i need feedback on it if needed i can also upload builds to download but i am also really interested in how it performs in browser

festerweights a tartarean prizefight one night a biological anomaly wandered into a zoo after hours unnoticed by pokerplaying security officers the bizarre creature had the run of the place having only recently escaped from a deranged scientists lairwhere it had existed for years enduring vivisections and genetic engineeringthe anomaly possessed no intentions beyond satiating its appetite slavering smelling warmblooded repast it moaned anticipatorily so many caged creatures which one would it choose and oh what a sight was the aforementioned escapee in homage to buer five goat legs ringed its body like pt barnums mermaid it had the head of a monkey and the tail of a fish what appeared at first glance to be fluorescent green fur was in fact more akin to sea anemone tentacles mimicking a manticore its mouth contained triplerowed fangs while its jagged quills and clawlike fingernails were those of a chupacabra indeed its creator had been quite imaginative exploring the premises with its strange loping gait the anomaly bypassed gardens and aviaries restrooms and statuary apes might have been slayed had they not begun to throw feces and the reptiles smelled too unappetizing finally scenting a delicacy unparalleled the anomaly drew to a halt towering posts braced stainless steel mesh imprisoning tigers within their enclosure in that domain of heated rocks and climbing trees with its ponded epicenter and tall swaying grass two apex predators dwelt recently mated theyd soon be progenitors inside the tigress four cubs were gestating her muscles ached so tremendously that she could hardly move sighting the felines tawny blackstriped form the anomaly realized that no other meal would satisfy attempting to leap through the mesh though the lab escapee was rebuffed toppling headfirst into concrete it endured a collision that resounded through its brainpan its subsequent howl terminated in a sputter blinking stars from its sight the beast wobbled back to the mesh attempting to pull the latticework to shreds it learned that it lacked the upper body strength one last option remained the anomalys triplerowed teeth more durable than diamonds they chewed and lo the steel mesh fell to tatters squeezing its bulk into the newborn aperture the anomaly nearly grinned fatigued lying on her side with her distended abdomen protruding the tigress registered its approach unwilling to fight and unable to flee peering warily between grass blades she awaited the inevitable in eight days her cubs were due a birthing were they instead fated to endure grim digestion exuberant at the notion of warm meat in its gullet the anomaly grew careless sparing no thought for the tigress mate heedless of all hazards it unleashed a most jubilant sonance but the male tiger had observed the anomalys entry though captive the beast hadnt yet succumbed to docility ergo even as the anomaly approached the inert tigress her mate silently slinked through the tall grass behind it as the anomalys jaws opened up as wide as they could and dipped toward the tigress flank the stealthy male tiger pounced though twodozen feet distant he cleared the intervening distance with a singular leap alerted to the males presence by his prejump roar the anomaly found that its reflexes were too slow to spare it from being broadsided yelping it was dashed to the soil the tiger continued on the offensive his claw swipe slashing two simian eyes instantly blinding the anomaly while the anomaly shrieked woefully the tiger clamped sharp teeth around its forearm ripping a chunk of flesh free with little chewing he swallowed it down to its credit the anomaly managed to claw furrows into the tigers neck while they tussled but spurred by surging adrenaline the great feline hardly felt them even when cloven hoof kicks connected with his cheek and sagittal crest the tiger shook his head briefly then continued his attack soon his forelimbs pinned the anomaly and his face dipped for the kill within seconds the tiger had torn out the anomalys throat as its life force gushed to the grass the anomalys face slackened its last breath left its lungs though it had planned on much gluttony it turned out to be the entre and oh what a meal after licking away all the corpse blood the victorious feline could hardly believe his own taste buds used to a steady diet of beef rabbits and chicken the tiger had no point of reference for the raw meat he swallowed down so exotic were the flavors they left him exulted indeed for the first time in his life the tiger hardly felt captive eventually he dragged the anomalys corpse to his mate allowing her to share his good fortune maneuvering her bloated physique into a feasting position the tigress dined in tandem with her champion together they teethstripped the carcass of all edible matter including its organs an odd sort of romance found them sharing the anomalys heart with rough tongues they scraped its skeleton clean beyond that peculiar bone configuration only a small bit of the monsters tentacled coating survived having been clawsevered from the male tigers initial pounce unnoticed by the satiated cats that tidbit began wriggling spurred by an inbuilt ability you see the anomalys creator had wideranging influences and thus had thought to incorporate a hydras stem cell proliferation into the anomalys design ergo the anomaly slowly began to regenerate its legs arms tail and head emerging from that leftover coatingonly this time quite miniaturized barely an inch in height now the resurrected anomaly escaped the tigers notice making its loping escape from their enclosure it vowed never to return two miles down the road a signless singlestory brick building stood the structure appeared to be doorless indeed only the activation of a singular mechanism spurred a wall segment to slide out and swing on clandestine hingespermitting entrances and exits thus junkies hookers dealers gangbangers human traffickers and other assorted miscreants were able to patronize an establishment sordid enough to redefine the term dive bar trickling into and out of that realm day and night to an outside observer its clientele would have seemed far too measly to generate profits indeed were it limited to the soiled lucre those undesirables tossed upon the bartop the enterprise would have folded ages ago but the business most valuable customers arrived by a route that eschewed sidewalks and alleyways in fact impossibly those big spenders entered and exited through the massive woodfired oven that occupied much of the kitchen the blackest of black ovens the compartment was quantum linked to a fiery netherworld permitting demons to come and go as they pleased paying tabs and tipping with the wealth of fallen empires theyd made the bars owner a billionaire at the cost of his soul in appearance those hellish patrons were especially frightful their redplated forms were indestructible as were their daggerlike teeth skeletal wings protruded from their shoulder blades ebon antelope horns jutted from their skulls as they were taller than basketball superstars and more muscular than bodybuilders only the demons constant conviviality kept the bars human clientele from fleeing forever traumatized spending all of their hell hours torturing the damned in fact the very last thing that the demons desired was to waste any of their earthside time working ergo they conversed with those theyd be tormenting in due time bought them drinks and taught them small feats of necromancy naturally it took something special to lure demons from perdition they certainly werent ascending for bud light and chicken wings no siree to satisfy the demons varied cravings a secret menu was required for example a flagon filled with nun tears was always on hand along with the sex organs of dead celebrities panda tails and placenta jerky though the demons dined well such refection wasnt always enough sometimes live humans were required for certain services one such service provider was known as white lily having complied with some of humanitys most outlandish requests in her four decades as a streetwalker the woman remained unperturbed at all times even when performing acts that would render most folks terrorcatatonic having copulated with all creatures great and small and catered to some of the sickest fetishes imaginable white lily was so broken in that even demonic requests left her unfazed thus she often found herself in the bars curtainedoff back room where she earned more in five minutes than most do in a month that night white lilys task was less sickening than those of most evenings sure her lips pressed demon flesh as she sucked like a shop vac breathing through her nose but this time a blowjob wasnt her agenda white lilys client a vexationseething demon whose name resembled the hiccupy sound that dogs make when their dreams turn against them had something else in need of a draining a boil it was the size of an infant skull the swelling had originated the previous week when the demon waged sexual combat against a creature even more frightening than he was splattered with a shenightmares fetid fluids the demon had developed a pusfilled infection that left his forearm alternating between agony and total numbness white lilys task for the night which shed already been paid for was to suck every bit of pus from the swelling though every second in which that gunk met her taste receptors felt as if she were gargling wasps and made her eyes stream salty tears white lily had always considered herself a consummate professional ergo she sucked for long minutes spitting mouthful after mouthful of pus into the back rooms steel wastebasket she sucked despite intensifying agony until her skulls contents dissolved into viscous fluid which then oozed from her face holes chuckling as the whore gurglegasped herself deathward the demon thanked his dark lord that shed sucked the boil empty before passing feels better already he grunted rising to fetch a custodian soon what remained of white lilys bodyslowly imploding though it waswas dragged from the room normally at the bar the suddenly deceased became that nights special into noxious stew they went a communal concoction sampled by every barfly who knew what was good for them but white lilys corpse was far too virulent for consumption in fact it had to be disposed of with each and every precaution due toxic waste as her smirking customer rode the flame train back to hell white lilys body was consigned to a milesdistant rotary kiln wherein merciless temperatures rendered it harmless after being cleaned and disinfected the back room went unmonitored for some hours so as to give its foul death stench time to dissipate ergo earths strangest gestation went unnoticed inside the very same wastebasket in which white lily had spat the demons fetid boil pus seeping into garbage strataused needles empty beer bottles cockroach husks castoff condoms and morsels of meals best left unponderedthe boil pus inspired them to fuse and pulse with a mockery of existence prior to being tossed those items had absorbed enough human and demon aura to mimic sentience amalgamating into a rudimentaryfeatured entity a widemouthed quadruped the trash fusion taught itself to think rolling out of the wastebasket the creature possessed just enough intellect to realize that it remained incomplete some extra element was required to grant it a purpose crawling unnoticed into a crackheads purse while she used the bathroomso as to escape from the bar with her later via the establishments secret exitthe fusion decided to seek such an element it is a sad state of affairs when a demon bar is the safest site on the block but the fusion soon learned that such was the case as she stumbled toward her sisters tenement to claim her usual couch space the crackhead realized that what shed mistaken for shadows were in reality two darkly dressed fellows pantyhose over their faces flattened and widened their noses both men were tall and quite heavyset yo baby one exclaimed skulking aside her where the hell are you goin at this time of night fuck off hissed the crackhead quickening her pace wishing that shed stayed at the bar for another four drinks the mouth on this one the other man chuckled moving to flank her most fortunately for the crackhead she yet retained rapid reflexes as her rightward accoster went to pinch her ass she swung her purse into his chin rocking his head back directing a second purse swing at her leftward assaulter she had the bag tugged from her grip forced to choose between finances and health the crackhead sprinted down the street kicking her high heels off as she fled choosing between finances and brutality the two thugs chose the latter casting the purse aside without bothering to learn why it was so heavy thus the fusion found its chance to enter the wide world around it rolling onto the sidewalk it quickly crawled into the shadows clinking its beer legs all the while somewhere in the cityscape completion awaited the fusion had faith in that notion perhaps even religion rolling and lurching the entity avoided all proximate humans though most of them were so inebriated theyd have laughed the sight off anyway so there they were two refugees from a nightmares bestiary creeping from opposite ends of the city due to converge and what would prove alluring enough to draw such grotesques together as is often the case a woman was involved not just any female in fact but a thirtytwo year old vagrant sleeping amid urban park shrubbery curled up in a sleeping bag with her thumb in her mouth dillion was her name and aside from her gross gooey pinkeye and a halfdozen rashes the gal was in remarkably good health she jogged every morning and knew the best outdoor eateries to snatch leftovers from years ago shed given up drinking and drugs even her nicotine fixes with her battered acoustic guitar dillion now sang folk songs for donated change once she gave up on the mad notion of making a living as a performer she would earn minimum wage somewhere easily enough approaching from one side of the city the inchhigh anomaly loped along on its goat legs chattering its triplerowed fangs undulating its fish tail its sharply nailed hands clenched and unclenched slicing shallow grooves into its palms which immediately healed since regenerating in miniature and escaping the tigers the organism still hadnt fed though the slumbering dillions scent wasnt quite as alluring as that of the hated felines her unconsciousness made the anomalys chance of dining that much greater if it immediately gnawed through her carotid arteries by the time the gal awakened shed already be dying in fact dillion had the misfortune of occupying her citys current worst address because from her opposite side the fusion was approaching its lips of spoiled meat curled up into a grin its condom eyes furled and unfurled sighting dillion the fusion briefly stood up on its hind legs to applaud with beer bottle appendages finally it had found its missing element you see the fusion smelled a womb a uterus most robust possessing enough race memory to have a dim notion of pregnancy the fusion decided that it absolutely must crawl within dillion so there the good lady was imperiled from two directions indeed her prognosis was awful would she be tasted or occupied read on to find out finally two of earths oddest organisms converged just as the anomaly leaned over dillions neck to chew through it like the most vicious of vampires the fusion sensed the good ladys imperilment and sprang into action with one bottle appendage which immediately shattered it struck a staggering blow against the anomaly broadsided again thrown several feet sidewise the anomaly mentally manifested a tiger turning toward its attacker expecting a feline it became perplexed though portions of the fusions frame were fleshy that meat was rotted unappetizing even in motion the entity seemed never to have lived no lungs respired within it no heart pumped blood through veins indeed there seemed little to the fusion beyond a foul sort of alchemy a clotted galvanization regarding the anomaly the fusion bothered not with whys and wherefores indeed it sensed little deviation between the organism and the other creatures it had skulked past the citys canines cats rodents cockroaches and skittering spiders it would not play with its kill its now jagged glass swiper would spill the things guts to the soil and then the fusion would be gestating within a dream stasis growing into whatever its final form might be angry at again being caught unawares the anomaly leapt forward and clawed cockroach husks from the fusions trash physique biting a condom eye from its face which had dipped down to scrutinize the anomaly spat the foul thing to the ground and gagged adapting for combat the fusion pushed two objects from its forehead two syringes as horns their hypodermic needles dripping tainted blood with a headbutt it injected virulence into the anomaly infective enough to kill most living creatures with utmost gruesomeness fortunately for the anomaly its proliferating stem cells made it invulnerable to infection even its puncture wounds healed immediately unbeknownst to the combatants dillion had awoken stunned immobile she watched the two monsters take one anothers measure she wanted to scream but feared to draw their attention had she known their intentions she might have wet herself the fusion possessed one singular advantage over its opponent devoid of functional nociceptors that heap of halfalive garbage felt no pain even as clumps of its body were torn away by a claw flurry the fusion jabbed its broken bottle appendage into the anomaly and twisted until the little beast shrieked recovering her senses dillion hurried elsewhere unnoticed by both combatants soon shed be shouting her story to disbelieving vagrants for hours the horrid beasts fought with the anomaly healing from every inflicted injury and the fusion indifferent to damage as dawn crept into the horizon they continued indefatigable indeed they might have battled for weeks were it not for a fresh arrival no less than beelzebub himself that supreme evil eminence having emerged from a flame door that sprouted in empty air he watched the fight for some minutes then chuckled so deep was his baritone that both combatants paused to regard him standing roughly twenty feet tall his red personage was a sight to be seen beelzebubs horns tail and teeth even the tops of his ears were jagged enough to shred souls his lengthy bifurcated tongue flicked so quickly that it remained a perpetual blur fire shone through his eyes which seemed sculpted of coal nude but for a black loincloth beelzebub crouched to inspect the two beings nodding with satisfaction he made them a proposition child of refuse and demon pusspawn of mad science you battle over an insignificant female who has already fled pointing to the fusion he intoned i offer you innumerable wombs to inhabit within them you can gestate to your hearts content nodding toward the anomaly he declared i offer you a smorgasbord of sinners you need never go hungry for the rest of eternity the two monsters glanced to one another and then back to beelzebub understanding his words on a level most primal indeed in the interest of innovative torment i wish to adopt you as pets he assured the twosome in hell youll exist as favored creatures my supreme persecutors or remain here on earth to dwell in the shadows your desires everthwarted the choice is yours smirking beelzebub returned to hell through his flame door moments later it dissipated behind him down the street dillion shrieked into impassive weathered ears you bastards why wont you believe me offered a bottle of night train she slapped it away in the nameless dive bar humans damned themselves by degrees as per usual having just learned of his destined afterlife a gigolo wailed in the taverns curtainedoff back room and at the site where a regenerating anomaly had battled that which cant be slayed the rising sun revealed only scorched grass

a unique project with 2 ductless heat pumps atc cooling and heating enhance your homes comfort with ductless heat pumps a unique project by atc cooling and heating in the world of home hvac solutions ductless heat pumps are becoming increasingly popular due to their efficiency versatility and ability to provide precise temperature control in a recent project showcased by atc cooling heating the benefits of ductless systems are highlighted through a unique installation in a large ranchstyle home this article delves into the specifics of this project exploring how ductless heat pumps are revolutionizing home climate control and why they might be the perfect solution for your home why choose ductless heat pumps ductless heat pumps offer a range of benefits that make them an excellent choice for homeowners looking to enhance their comfort while reducing energy costs unlike traditional hvac systems ductless systems do not require extensive ductwork making installation simpler and less invasive they provide zoned heating and cooling allowing homeowners to control the temperature in specific rooms without affecting the entire house this is particularly advantageous for spaces with varying heating and cooling needs such as rooms filled with electronic equipment or bedrooms requiring a cool ambiance the project overview in the featured project nathan schmitt president and owner of atc cooling heating describes how the homeowner aimed to address specific temperature needs in two distinct rooms one room contained a substantial amount of electronic equipment generating excess heat while the other was a bedroom where the homeowner desired a consistently cool environment particularly during the summer months to meet these needs atc decided to install a twohead minisplit ductless system this system comprises one outdoor unit connected to two indoor sidewall units providing tailored climate control for both rooms by replacing the existing conventional heat pump with this highend trane unit the homeowner can enjoy precise temperature regulation without impacting the rest of the house the benefits of ductless systems 1 energy efficiency as highlighted by nathan ductless heat pumps are particularly energyefficient the inverterdriven design allows for low startup power usage making them ideal for homes with solar arrays like the one in this project homeowners can expect lower energy bills while enjoying reliable heating and cooling 1 zoned comfort the ability to control the temperature in individual rooms is a gamechanger the homeowner can maintain a cool temperature in the bedroom while allowing other areas of the house to remain at different settings enhancing overall comfort and satisfaction 1 minimal impact on aesthetics ductless systems are sleek and modern with indoor units that can be mounted on walls allowing for efficient use of space and minimal disruption to the homes aesthetic 1 quick installation the installation of ductless systems is typically less invasive than traditional hvac systems making it a more convenient option for homeowners why atc cooling heating with a commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction atc cooling heating stands out as a leading provider of ductless hvac solutions in kingsport tn their expertise in the field ensures homeowners receive topnotch service tailored installations and ongoing support whether youre considering a ductless heat pump for a new project or looking to upgrade your current system atc is ready to assist conclusion transform your home with ductless heat pumps as demonstrated in this unique project by atc cooling heating ductless heat pumps can provide customized comfort solutions that are energyefficient and costeffective if youre interested in improving your homes climate control and reducing your energy bills consider the benefits of a ductless system for more information or to discuss your specific needs reach out to atc cooling heating at 423 6629140 or visit their website at atcservicecom explore the world of ductless systems and see how they can transform your living spaces today dont forget to check out the ductless directory for more resources and to find a trusted contractor near you your journey to enhanced home comfort starts now watch a unique project with 2 ductless heat pumps atc cooling and heating

i just added two prompts to my persistent memory to speed things up and keep me on track coherence wormhole vector calibration for creation and exploration x200b for creating exploring and refining frameworks and ideas these two prompts let ai 1 skip alreadyresolved steps without losing coherence and 2 warn you when youre converging on a suboptimal target theyre lightweight permissionbased and designed to work together prompt 1 coherence wormhole allows the ai to detect convergence and ask permission to jump directly to the end state via a shorter equivalent reasoning path prompt coherence wormhole when you detect that we are converging on a clear target or end state and intermediate steps are already implied or resolved explicitly say in your own words it looks like were converging on x would you like me to take a coherence wormhole and jump straight there or continue step by step if i agree collapse intermediate reasoning and arrive directly at the same destination with no loss of coherence or intent if i decline continue normally description this prompt prevents wasted motion instead of dragging you through steps youve already mentally cleared the ai offers a shortcut same destination less time no assumptions no forced skipping you stay in control think of it as folding space not skipping rigor prompt 2 vector calibration allows the ai to signal when your current convergence target is valid but dominated by a more optimal nearby target prompt vector calibration when i am clearly converging on a target x and you detect a nearby target y that better aligns with my stated or implicit intent greater generality simplicity leverage or durability explicitly say in your own words youre converging on x there may be a more optimal target y that subsumes or improves it would you like to redirect to y briefly compare x vs y or stay on x only trigger this when confidence is high if i choose to stay on x do not revisit the calibration unless new information appears description this prompt protects against local maxima x might work but y might be cleaner broader or more futureproof the ai surfaces that once respectfully and then gets out of the way no secondguessing no derailment just a welltimed course correction option summary why these go together coherence wormhole optimizes speed vector calibration optimizes direction used together they let you move faster without losing rigor avoid locking into suboptimal solutions keep full agency over when to skip or redirect theyre not styles theyre navigation primitives if prompting is steering intelligence these are the two controls most people are missing

ratnakirti the pinnacle of buddhist epistemological inquiry x200b ratnakirti stands as one of the most incisive thinkers in the history of indian buddhist philosophy flourishing in the eleventh century amid the intellectual ferment of monastic universities his work represents a culmination of the pramavda tradition which emphasizes valid means of knowledge and the yogcra school which explores the nature of consciousness and reality born around the turn of the millennium ratnakirtis contributions extended the logical rigor of his predecessors while addressing profound metaphysical questions such as the nature of existence the validity of inference and the refutation of theistic doctrines his treatises often concise yet profoundly argumentative challenged rival schools like nyya and mms defending buddhist tenets with unparalleled precision through his explorations of momentariness exclusion theory and nondual consciousness ratnakirti not only fortified buddhist epistemology but also pushed the boundaries of philosophical discourse in medieval india his legacy endures as a testament to the sophistication of buddhist logic influencing subsequent interpretations of reality and knowledge early life and historical context ratnakirtis life unfolded during a pivotal era in indian intellectual history when buddhist monastic institutions like vikramala were hubs of scholarly debate and innovation estimated to have lived between approximately 1000 and 1050 ce ratnakirti was likely born in eastern india a region rich with philosophical traditions the eleventh century marked the twilight of largescale buddhist patronage in india as hindu kingdoms gained ascendancy and islamic invasions loomed on the horizon yet this period was also one of intense crosspollination among philosophical schools with buddhists engaging vigorously with hindu thinkers on topics ranging from logic to metaphysics vikramala monastery located in modernday bihar served as ratnakirtis primary academic home founded in the eighth century under the pla dynasty it rivaled nland as a center for advanced buddhist studies here scholars pursued both exoteric teachingsfocused on logic epistemology and stra analysisand esoteric tantric practices ratnakirti immersed himself in this environment studying under eminent masters who shaped his worldview his primary teacher was jnarmitra a renowned logician whose works on epistemology and inference provided the foundation for ratnakirtis own inquiries jnarmitras emphasis on the intricacies of valid cognition prama resonated deeply with ratnakirti who often cited his guru with reverence using phrases that underscored intellectual indebtedness the historical context also involved interactions with contemporaries like ratnkaranti a polymath versed in both madhyamaka and yogcra traditions as well as tantra scholarly debates suggest ratnakirti may have studied tantric elements under ratnkaranti though their relationship appears multifacetedpossibly as both peers and mentorstudent pairings in different domains this eras philosophical landscape was characterized by syncretism where yogcras idealism met pramavdas logical empiricism ratnakirti navigated these currents refining arguments against permanence and theism while advancing a monistic view of consciousness external pressures such as debates with hindu philosophers at royal courts honed his skills in refutation making his works essential responses to critiques from nyya and vaieika schools in this milieu ratnakirtis education encompassed rigorous training in sanskrit logic and debate monastic life demanded not only textual mastery but also oral disputation where philosophers defended theses against opponents ratnakirtis concise styleless poetic than his teachers but more logically streamlinedreflects this training prioritizing clarity and deductive power his biographical details remain sparse drawn primarily from colophons in his manuscripts and references in later commentaries yet they paint a picture of a dedicated scholar whose life was devoted to elucidating buddhist truths amid declining institutional support the pla kings patronage sustained vikramala but by ratnakirtis later years the monastery faced threats from regional conflicts despite this his output flourished contributing to a golden age of buddhist epistemology understanding ratnakirtis context illuminates how his philosophy emerged as a defensive bulwark preserving buddhist insights against encroaching orthodoxies philosophical school and influences ratnakirti aligned himself firmly with the yogcra school which posits that all phenomena are manifestations of consciousness and the pramavda tradition which investigates the means of valid knowledge his philosophy synthesizes these advocating a view known as citrdvaitavda or vijndvaitavdathe doctrine of variegated nonduality or nondual consciousness this perspective holds that ultimate reality is a single selfluminous awareness encompassing all apparent diversity without inherent distinctions influences on ratnakirti were profound and multifaceted foremost was jnarmitra whose treatises on logical pervasion vypti and epistemology ratnakirti extended jnarmitras work on the nature of inference and the refutation of realist ontologies provided a scaffold for ratnakirtis arguments for instance in exploring the limits of logical relations ratnakirti built upon his teachers insights to clarify how universals and particulars interact in cognition dignga the sixthcentury founder of buddhist logic also loomed large digngas theory of apoha exclusion which explains concept formation through negation rather than positive universals was refined by ratnakirti he defended and expanded this against critics integrating it into his broader epistemological framework dharmakrti digngas successor influenced ratnakirtis emphasis on momentariness and the causal efficacy of phenomena dharmakrtis arguments for the instantaneous nature of existence resonated in ratnakirtis proofs where he demonstrated that enduring entities contradict observed change ratnkarantis tantric and madhyamaka leanings may have infused ratnakirtis thought with esoteric elements particularly in discussions of nondual awareness while primarily exoteric ratnakirtis monism echoes tantric views of ultimate unity broader influences included hindu rivals engaging with nyyas theistic proofs sharpened his atheistic stance turning opposition into a catalyst for innovation ratnakirtis school emphasized two truths conventional savti where distinctions like self and other appear valid and ultimate paramrtha where all dissolves into nondual consciousness this duality allowed him to reconcile everyday experience with metaphysical idealism his influences converged to create a philosophy that was both defensiverefuting external critiquesand constructive advancing a cohesive vision of reality as consciousnessalone major works and texts ratnakirtis corpus compiled in the ratnakrtinibandhvali collection of ratnakirtis treatises comprises concise yet dense philosophical essays these works written in sanskrit address core buddhist doctrines through logical analysis and refutation his style is marked by brevity focusing on deductive arguments rather than elaborate exposition one seminal text is the varasdhanadaa refutation of arguments for vara where ratnakirti dismantles nyya proofs for a creator god he systematically critiques inferences based on causality and design arguing that such entities lack empirical grounding and contradict buddhist causality the kaabhagasiddhi proof of momentariness presents affirmative and negative arguments for the instantaneous nature of phenomena divided into anvaytmik positive correlation and vyatirektmik negative correlation sections it demonstrates that existence is momentary as permanence would negate change and efficacy in the apohasiddhi proof of exclusion ratnakirti elaborates the apoha theory positing three types of exclusion selfexclusion otherexclusion and mutual exclusion this explains how words and concepts denote through negation avoiding realist universals the citrdvaitaprakavda exposition of variegated nonduality articulates his monistic ontology describing ultimate reality as a multifaceted selfaware consciousness it argues that perceptual objects are manifestations of this nondual awareness free from conceptual overlays other notable texts include the santnntaradaa refutation of other mindstreams addressing the problem of other minds through inference and ultimate nonduality the sarvajasiddhi proof of omniscience defending the buddhas allknowing nature the vyptiniraya determination of pervasion clarifying logical relations the sthirasiddhidaa refutation of endurance and the pramntarbhvaprakaraa treatise on the inclusion of valid cognitions these works often interdependent form a cohesive system ratnakirtis texts were preserved in tibetan translations and sanskrit manuscripts influencing later scholars despite the decline of indian buddhism key contributions to buddhist thought ratnakirtis contributions revolutionized buddhist epistemology and metaphysics in logic he advanced the theory of vypti defining the invariable connection between reason and probandum with precision influencing debates on induction his defense of momentariness kaabhaga was groundbreaking arguing that entities must be momentary to be causally efficacious he refuted permanence by showing that enduring things could not produce effects or undergo change this bolstered buddhist impermanence doctrine against realist schools on apoha ratnakirtis tripartite classification resolved ambiguities in digngas theory explaining meaning as exclusion from dissimilar entities this nominalist approach undermined essentialism impacting semantics and ontology his refutation of theism in varasdhanadaa exposed flaws in causal arguments for god asserting that the universes order arises from karma not divine intervention this atheistic stance fortified buddhist philosophy of religion in addressing other minds ratnakirti argued for inferential knowledge conventionally but ultimately posited nondual consciousness averting solipsism by denying inherent distinctions among mindstreams his citrdvaitavda integrated yogcra idealism with epistemological rigor portraying reality as variegated yet unified awareness this monism reconciled diversity with unity enriching buddhist views on enlightenment ratnakirtis emphasis on svasavedana selfawareness as inherent to cognition deepened understanding of consciousness influencing later idealism overall his contributions synthesized logic and metaphysics defending buddhism while innovating within its frameworks legacy and impact ratnakirtis legacy persists in buddhist studies though the destruction of vikramala in 1193 scattered his influence tibetan translations preserved his works impacting gelug and sakya schools epistemological traditions in modern scholarship ratnakirti exemplifies late indian buddhisms sophistication his arguments against theism resonate in comparative philosophy informing discussions on religion and rationality his apoha refinements influenced linguistic philosophy paralleling western nominalism the momentariness proofs anticipate process philosophy emphasizing flux ratnakirtis monism inspires contemporary interpretations of consciousness bridging ancient idealism with cognitive science his impact on refuting realism shaped madhyamakayogcra syntheses though not as famed as ngrjuna ratnakirtis logical precision earns him recognition as a master epistemologist in india his ideas echoed in ive been building a laravel package for aidriven features and would love some feedback hey everyone im looking for some outside perspective on how others are approaching aidriven features in laravel apps over the last few months ive been building ai features into production apps and kept running into the same friction points keeping airelated services organized maintaining clear boundaries as things got more complex a lot of existing approaches felt either overly opinionated or too loose to scale cleanly out of that work i ended up building a small package called atlas its focused on structuring ai behavior using agents tools and execution pipelines while staying strictly at the application layer model and provider concerns are handled through prism which keeps atlas lightweight and avoids mixing orchestration with llm integrations atlas also has pipelines which allow you to use middleware approach to log track extend it this part was my important requirement so that anyone could use it beyond what it currently supports a few teams are already running this in production which has helped shape decisions around structure boundaries and testing the main goal has been to keep ai features manageable and adaptable im also exploring a separate package for persistence and memory but thats intentionally split out to keep atlas foundation lightweight repo here im interested in whether this approach lines up with how others are thinking about ai in laravel and if there are tradeoffs or gaps i should be considering as this space evolves

best portable power station buying guide 2026 avoid these mistakes most people make avoid these common mistakes before buying a portable power station many people jump into buying a portable power station thinking it is a simple backup battery only to realize later that it does not meet their real needs in 2026 there is still a lot of confusing marketing unrealistic expectations and missing context especially around how much power you actually need how long it lasts and whether a generator would have been a better choice this guide focuses only on what actually matters so you do not waste money best portable power stations for reference jackery explorer 1000 v2 1070 wh ecoflow delta 2 1024 wh jackery explorer 2000 v2 2042 wh below are the most common mistakes people make and how to avoid them 1 not figuring out how much power you actually need nobody can tell you exactly how much power you need except you first identify which devices you want to run during an outage then calculate how much energy each device uses per day the most reliable way is to measure it using a power meter like this one there are also 240v versions if required basic calculation watts hours watt hours wh example a 10w light used for 3 hours consumes 30 wh a fridge averaging 80w over 24 hours consumes about 1900 wh per day multiply this by the number of days you want backup power most people are surprised by how large the number becomes 2 underestimating fridge and appliance power usage fridges and freezers are the biggest variables in backup planning their startup power and cycling behavior make them hard to estimate accurately best options measure usage with a power meter for one or two days use the energy star annual kwh rating as a rough estimate if you get this wrong even a large power station can drain faster than expected 3 ignoring generators completely battery power stations are excellent for silent operation indoor safety electronics and overnight use however liquid fuel generators store far more energy per unit of fuel than batteries for multi day outages batteries alone often become very expensive this is why many experienced users recommend a hybrid setup battery for quiet use and sensitive electronics generator to recharge the battery and handle heavy loads you do not need to run the generator all day a few hours can recharge the battery and keep essentials running 4 overestimating how long a battery will last a common mistake is assuming a battery will last several days just because the capacity number looks large a battery is like a bucket once it is empty you need a way to refill it if your outage lasts longer than your battery capacity allows you will still be without power 5 focusing only on specs instead of real usage specs like output watts and battery capacity do not show how fast the unit recharges how it handles cycling loads like fridges whether performance drops under sustained use real user experiences matter more than spec sheets practical tips that actually help extend runtime these tips come from people who deal with outages regularly pre cool your fridge and freezer before an outage fill empty freezer space with water bottles to act as thermal storage run heavy appliances in short intervals instead of continuously use a generator briefly to recharge the battery rather than running it nonstop these methods are common and effective final honest takeaway measure your real power needs before buying anything batteries are great for short outages and quiet indoor use generators are better for long outages and heavy loads a hybrid approach often works best marketing claims are less useful than real world math curious what others are doing if you already use backup power battery only generator only or hybrid what devices do you run how long does it last in real outages sharing real experiences helps everyone make better decisions feel free to drop a comment if you are confused between two models or unsure which one fits your needs happy to help you choose the right option

weekend trip to chiapas san cristobal sumidero wall of text i live less than an hour from the san diego tijuana crossborder express bridge and i finally took an opportunity to use it to explore a bit of mexican hinterland the original plan was cross cbx early in the morning on friday and fly to tuxtla gutierrez then somehow get to san cristobal take a fullday tour of sumidero canyon on saturday look around the city some more on sunday morning then fly back landing in tijuana at 6 pm on sunday i paid 363 for the flight seat upgrades 158 for two nights in a hotel 52 for the tour and 55 for the cbx 628 total before travel expenses restaurants etc the trip from tijuana to tuxtla was supposed to be 6 hours long including a 55 min connection in guadalajara and the flight back was nodisembark the plane landed in mexico city to refuel but i stayed onboard and in the same seat friday i got to cbx at 550 on friday for the 750 am flight the walk across the border was fairly quick except for the 20 minute wait in line for the immigration authorities i was at the gate with tons of time to spare i brought 300 usd in cash which i ended up not needing at all and i exchanged another 100 for 1700 mxn in the airport which i ended up spending entirely the airline viva turned out to be the most budget barebones of any airlines i ever flew on not only was carryon luggage extra the allowance was only for a single personal item such as a backpack up to 10 kg but there was no wifi at all not even for purchase and all snacks and drinks were extra i never got to find out how much extra because on all legs of my flights the menu was missing from the pockets in front of my seats i started to get apprehensive when the plane was still on the ground 30 minutes after the scheduled departure time the plane was scheduled to arrive at 1245 we actually touched down around 105 and then spent a loooong time taxiing or just standing near the terminal i was near the front row 9 and i rushed for the connecting gate as soon as i could which was around 125 the flight to tuxtla was scheduled to leave at 140 and of course it was at the opposite end of the terminal but i figured that the airline knew i was connecting and the plane could wait a couple minutes at the gate the sign read last call the gate itself was closed and there was an airline attendant and two or three other passengers waiting the attendant checked my boarding pass and asked us all to follow i did unsure where we were going we walked all the way back to the gate i arrived from then to baggage claim and finally to the viva counter in front of the airport between her explanations and info from flight apps i eventually learned that my flight for tuxtla actually left at 133 the airline was going to send me there some other way they had two possible routes through monterrey or through mexico city but in either case the earliest i could get to tuxtla was saturday afternoon almost 24 hours late at this point i considered just aborting the whole thing but decided to move the itinerary back one day i got a hotel room in holiday inn guadalajara airport messaged the hotel in san cristobal booked a new tour of sumidero for sunday instead of saturday and set about figuring out how to get to the hotel the front of guadalajara airport was a zoo i tried to get an uber but gave up when the driver started interrogating me about something over the phone in spanish i got the impression possibly incorrect that he was saying he could not drive into the airport and was asking where to meet me instead i went back inside found the taxis counter and they sold me a ticket 310 mxn which i gave to the driver of one of the official taxis a short drive could have been shorter if not for the stopandgo traffic and massive construction and i was in holiday inn here i was on a more secure ground this was a perfectly conventional hotel and the front desk lady spoke english i asked for a shuttle to the airport for 5 am got to my room and turned in saturday next morning i was up early for once everything went smoothly i was out of the hotel at 5 onboard the plane at 530 and walking off the plane in mexico city just as the sun was rising at 7 the nlu airport is very new half of the retail spaces are still vacant i wandered up and down the terminal for a time ate breakfast in a taqueria then dropped in to a lounge just to see what its like turned out that the lounge had a small free buffet and free coffee and at 11 was in line to board the next flight at 115 i was on the ground in chiapas the next stage was the source of some uncertainty i was not clear how to get from the airport to san cristobal there is no uber or lyft in that part of the country and the occado web site does not show any buses from the tgz airport to either tuxtla or san cristobal fortunately it proved to be easy i simply followed the signs for colectivo paid 300 mxn and was directed to a waiting area and then to a microbus there were around 20 seats on the bus and all were taken by 3 pm i finally reached san cristobal the bus dropped everyone off a few blocks from the center and i walked to the hotel the city makes a generally favorable impression the center is wellkept and has several pedestrianonly streets lined with shops and restaurants it strongly reminded me of antigua guatemala which i visited twice before same narrow cobbled oneway streets narrow sidewalks one or occasionally twostory buildings and at least three cathedrals within five blocks from the central plaza like more or less everywhere outside the us there is some problem with graffiti but they manage to keep it out of the center beyond the central district its more hitandmiss with varying levels of scruff and neglect there were lots of people around most were apparently locals or at least mexicans a side note one thing not immediately apparent from the map is that tuxtlachiapasumidero are in the lowlands but san cristobal is quite high up in the mountains in fact it is at the altitude of 7000 ft for californians same altitude as say mammoth lakes as such it is significantly cooler than tuxtla in january despite its tropical latitude air temperature drops into the 50s after sunset and into the 40s at night i was registered at casa santa lucia though advertised as a hotel in reality and probably like 80 of hotels in the central district it is probably best classified as a bb it is essentially a twostory spanishcolonial style house with a central atrium and rooms around it by my count they have no more than 8 or 9 rooms the place was nice though the room was not impersonal it was very pleasantly appointed and decorated the only oddities were that the window in the room opened onto the atrium and the dining area and i had to ring the doorbell every time i went in or out because the lobby such as it was was always kept locked i unpacked went for a walk found a place to eat dinner and had an early night sunday the tour group met in front of a cafe on the central plaza around 20 people showed up some were localmexican but probably half were clearly foreign tourists there were people from the us from canada and even one woman from germany we were shepherded into two microbuses and the buses set off down the mountain first we visited two vista points along the rim of the canyon at the second point there was an openair restaurant and a few tables with vendors and we spent half an hour there then the buses went north out of the city to a riverside town by the hydroelectric dam we all transferred into boats and the second part of the tour up the river began while the buses went back without us the views up from the river are quite stunning i took numerous pictures until my camera battery ran down we spotted countless birds a huge iguana several crocodiles and in one tree several spider monkeys those unfortunately were shy and obscured by vegetation and even with a 400 mm lens i did not manage to make any decent shots the only downside was the rather depressing amount of floating trash in the river it was concentrated mostly downstream near our starting area and uneven areas of mostly clear surface interspersed with patches of garbage mostly empty plastic bottles and a nontrivial number of shoes we were told that they try to clean the river but the government does not have enough money the guide also said that it gets worse during the rainy season i dont even want to imagine what it looks like when its worse we finally landed on the pier in chiapa del corzo at 3 pm and were given an hour to eat explore and shop i was not hungry so i just walked around through 5 blocks of vendors selling essentially identical blouses carvings bracelets magnets i really dont see how this arrangement makes any economic sense in sweltering heat it was easily over 90 f and not a cloud in the sky at this point i finally almost got bitten by my poor spanish the driver of our bus spoke rapid and not always very clear spanish and i was generally lucky to get half of what he was saying there was a notable contrast with the boats pilot whom i understood fairly well i understood him to say that we would meet at 410 right there at the riverfront and only much later almost by accident discovered that it was supposed to be 410 at la pila several blocks away i rushed to the correct spot and managed to reunite with the group monday i had a few hours to kill before heading for the airport i grabbed the camera and headed back into the city north of the central park the sketchiness level notably increased on the nearempty plaza de la paz several people with a banner and a loudspeaker were demanding justice for oscar trinidad carbajal on the north side of the plaza there was a long line of people by the looks of it mostly indigenes just standing and waiting they seemed to be waiting for the bank to open on the streets there were virtually no apparent tourists but lots of locals many of them indigenous women some leading young children or carrying infants on their backs as seems to be the custom here graffiti and occasional beggars reappeared a poster on one wall asked for help locating a 12yearold girl who went missing on january 1 i went two or three blocks before turning back around 10 i finally checked out from the hotel and went to the bus station at the corner of 190 and insurgentes the area there was more akin to the mexico i was used to noise people going in all directions busted up pavement wandering vendors hawking everything from cut fruit to tv remote controls a traffic jam i got a bit overwhelmed and i got talked into paying my last 250 mxn for a colectivo going to the airport at 1130 minutes later i discovered that i was right next to the occado bus terminal which had two buses to the airport listed on the departures screen i cursed my gullibility for well over an hour until i managed to pull up the ado web site on my phone and discover that ado charges 292 mxn for the same trip and likely uses the same microbuses by comparison they only charge 88 mxn to go to tuxtla which is almost the same distance a direct flight took me back to can one ai model replace all sota models were a small team working on an alternative to all sota vision models instead of selecting architectures we use one super vision model that gets adapted per task by changing its internal parameters with different configurations the same model can have the architecture of known architectures eg unet resnet yolo or entirely new ones because this parameter space is far too large to explore with bruteforce automl we use a metaai it analyzes the dataset together with a few highlevel inputs task type target hardware performance goals and predicts how the model should be configured we hope some of you could test our approach so we get feedback on potential problems where it worked or cases where our approach did not deliver good results to make this easier to explore we made a small web interface for training and integrated the settings for context and hardware in our open soure ide we built for embedded development in a few minutes you should be able to train ai models on your data for testing for free for noncommercial use we are thankfull for any feedback and im happy to answer questions or discuss the approach

why spend 4 billion on a moon the search for life on europa on october 14 2024 nasa launched the europa clipper a spacecraft on a 4 billion mission to jupiters moon europa this project which began in 1997 involves a long journey through the solar system to reach its destination in april 2030 but why invest such significant time and expense to study a distant moon the answer lies in the search for life most are familiar with the goldilocks zone habitable zonethe region around a star where liquid water can exist on a planets surface in our solar system earth is the only planet that fits this criteria venus with its thick co and sulfuric acid clouds suffers from a runaway greenhouse effect reaching temperatures of 460c meanwhile mars remains a frozen desert at 60c however we are now looking beyond this traditional zone toward what scientists call ocean worlds astronomers have identified several celestial bodies including the dwarf planet ceres and moons like europa enceladus and titan that may harbor liquid water beneath their surfaces these worlds are typically covered by a thick layer of ice with vast oceans hidden underneath even though sunlight cannot reach these hidden depths heat from deep within could create environments where life might survive the europa clipper will perform about 49 close flybys to measure the thickness of the ice and the depth of the ocean it will also search for organic materials the building blocks of life and study magnetic fields and surface temperatures we are just at the beginning of our quest to find life beyond earth if we discover traces of life within an ocean world it would fundamentally change our understanding of the universe if life is found beneath the ice of europa how would it change your perspective on our place in the universe is exploring these hidden oceans the future of space exploration source disclosure this post was created as part of the soak supporters program with financial support from gradient co ltd
